headline: Great Divide Mining advances Challenger gold mine toward cash flow with offtake deal and staged ramp to 25,000 oz/year

quote: Yeah we've we haven't given any any firm numbers to the market because we're adopting the crawl walk run sort of a strategy in that we've taken over an old plant and we've rejigged it to go from being a cyanide plant and transitioned it to being a concentrated plant that uses gravity recovery means. So being an old plant there's a lot of carryovers with historical electrical workings that have been degraded over time and those sorts of things so we're currently running it at about 50 percent throughput capacity. We'll slowly ramp that up over time so we're targeting probably something in the order of that couple hundred ounces per month initially... we're looking at that 25 000 ounces per annum capacity once we've got the underground going. So at that we've got about five years of ore ahead of us at that 25 000 ounce capacity but there's a lot more to come out of Adelong.
